identity.title: Add producer-neutral execution scope reference to canonical execution models

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Introduce the smallest canonical representation of an execution scope: an optional opaque scope_ref carried by execution-facing models without embedding pack, iteration, task, node, planner, coder, or other producer vocabulary.
human_pressure.why_now: Run-wide aggregation is insufficient for real multi-scope runs and 8052 freezes the contract before implementation.
do_not_misread: Do not build an execution graph.
Do not add producer-specific scope fields.
Do not change governance outcomes yet.
red_lines: No parent/child graph unless already required by the documented 8052 contract.
No behavior changes beyond preserving scope identity.

machine_core.goal: Add optional scope_ref to the minimal canonical execution and decision structures needed by later packs while preserving all existing behavior for events without scope_ref.
red_lines: No storage migration unless strictly required by current projection persistence contract.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path.
invariants: Absence of scope_ref preserves current run-level semantics.
Existing serialized models remain backward-compatible where the repository contract requires it.
Producer-specific concepts never appear in canonical core fields.

observable_effect.assertion: Canonical execution models can preserve an optional opaque scope_ref without changing existing unscoped behavior.

proofs.assertion: Model and projection tests prove scoped and unscoped compatibility.

failure_semantics: Missing scope_ref remains valid and means run-level scope.
Malformed non-string scope values are not silently converted into trusted scope identity.

steps.title: Add canonical scope_ref
details: Add the minimal optional opaque field where required by canonical execution/decision models.

steps.title: Preserve unscoped compatibility
details: Ensure existing events and projections with no scope_ref behave exactly as before.

steps.title: Add focused tests
details: Prove scoped values are preserved and malformed or absent values do not invent identity.

acceptance: Canonical execution structures expose optional scope_ref.
No producer-specific execution vocabulary is added.
No outcome or signal semantics change.

must_check: scope_ref is optional, opaque, and producer-neutral.
reject_if: An execution graph or registry is introduced.
Missing scope_ref is treated as an error.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused model/projection tests prove the new field; full suite protects serialization compatibility.
